exploit_name: Intra-epoch rateAtTarget updates allow compounding interest rate errors
description: Interest rate target recalculations occur mid-epoch without proper epoch boundary handling.
root_cause: Interest rate target recalculations occur mid-epoch without proper epoch boundary handling.
fix_description: Restrict rateAtTarget updates to epoch boundaries or implement epoch-aware interest calculation.
notes: Interest calculations diverge from intended curves, overstating or understating borrowing costs.
